model.description: Model identifier, e.g. black_scholes, binomial_crr, monte_carlo_gbm, implied_vol, forward, put_call_parity, digital, barrier, asian, trinomial, fd_bs, heston, lsmc_american, vasicek, hull_white

params.description: Model-specific parameters. Common names: spot, strike, rate (continuously compounded), div_yield, vol (annualized), time (year fraction), option_type ('call'|'put'), style ('european'|'american'), steps, paths, seed, antithetic.
